newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline drifts but some see tighter May.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline drifts but some see tighter May.

text.p: NWE gasoline was steady to slightly weaker on Wednesday in a quiet market, traders said.
Two Eurograde barges traded at $197 fob AR, one for the first half of May the other for the whole of May.

Prices were slightly weaker but many saw gains likely later, especially if NYMEX unleaded futures hold onto ACCESS gains. The May contract last traded a 0.23 cent higher at 62.00 cents a gallon on ACCESS.
A handful of sellers said they were refraining from offering material in the expectation that prices would strengthen over the coming 10 days.
"April's looking pretty sloppy," said one trader. "But looking into May the situation looks more hopeful."
On the cargo front, a number of players were on the starting blocks waiting for the arbitrage door to swing back open, but most said at the moment it was barely ajar.
"Unless you can get cheap freight or are shifting a large cargo it's not really feasible," said one trader.
